name: Harbor Lock
subtitle: Token cliff vesting
description: Example 7 — two token lock patterns: a batch time-lock anyone can fund, and a self-contained grant that escrows everything at deploy. Constant-time claims, 11u releases.
long_description: Lock ERC-20 tokens behind a cliff with linear release. Two trust structures in one folder: TokenTimeLock is a batch contract where anyone locks tokens for a beneficiary (no operator key, emergency brake on new locks only), and LinearVesting is a self-contained single grant that escrows its full amount in the constructor and needs no admin at all. Claim gas can be sponsored by anyone while the beneficiary always receives the funds. Storage is packed to two slots per lock; releases cost 11 state units.
